subject: Life Skills
title: The Power of Compound Interest
description: Learn The Power of Compound Interest in one minute.

hook.text: If you save $200 a month starting at 25, you will have more at 65 than someone saving $400 a month starting at 35.

buildup.text: Compound interest means earning interest on your interest. The longer your money sits, the more it multiplies itself.

discovery.text: At 7% average return, $200 a month for 40 years grows to over $520,000. The same amount for 30 years: only $243,000.

twist.text: Time matters more than amount. Starting 10 years early with less money often beats starting late with more.

climax.text: Open any investment account and start with whatever you can — even $50 a month.

punchline.text: Start now with little. Time does the heavy lifting.

quiz.question: Why does starting to save earlier matter so much?
options: Early savings earn higher interest rates
Compound interest has more time to multiply, exponentially growing the total
Banks give bonuses for long-term customers
